# Jiana Suites

> Boutique hotel directly opposite Arekere Lake in Lakshmi Layout, JP Nagar 7th Phase, Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India. Lake-view rooms for corporate, medical and family stays, close to Bannerghatta Road.

## Key facts
- Address: 435, 8th Cross Road, Lakshmi Layout, JP Nagar 7th Phase, Arekere, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560076
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 99000 75360
- Email: jianasuites@gmail.com
- Map pin: 12.891588, 77.58837
- 6 room types, several with Arekere Lake views
- Book direct by phone or WhatsApp, with no booking fee
- Free on-site parking

## Room types
- Premium King Lake View Room (king bed, full lake view)
- Premium King Partial Lake View Room (king bed, partial lake view)
- Premium Twin Lake View Room (2 single beds, lake view)
- Deluxe Twin Partial Lake View Room (2 single beds, partial lake view)
- Deluxe Queen Room (queen bed)
- Deluxe Queen Lake View Room (queen bed, lake view)

## Amenities
Free high-speed Wi-Fi, smart TV, 24-hour hot water, power backup, lift, CCTV, fire safety system, tea/coffee kettle, hair dryer, iron and board, toiletries, room service, daily housekeeping.

## Best for
- Medical visitors: close to Apollo Hospital and Fortis Hospital on Bannerghatta Road; twin rooms for attendants; monthly rates
- Corporate guests: near Brigade Millennium, Accenture and WeWork JP Nagar; work desks
- Long stays: monthly rates with daily housekeeping and laundry help
- Families and weekend trips: lake views; drive to Bannerghatta Biological Park

## Nearby
Arekere Lake (opposite), Bannerghatta Road, Brigade Millennium JP Nagar, Apollo Hospital, Fortis Hospital, IIM Bangalore, Christ University Bannerghatta Road campus, Hulimavu and IIMB stations on the Namma Metro Pink Line, Royal Meenakshi Mall, Bannerghatta Biological Park.
